scope: 2026-11-06 V4 CM03-derived breast vascular immune composition; state analysis optional, not prerequisite
acquisition: Six Xenium AnnData and all three author label-transfer levels only, selected by platform and lexical source order; complete members CRC/SHA; whole archive MD5 not certified
spatial_identity: Author major/minor/subset labels retained as external reference evidence; first qualify barcode joins, native expression scale, original micron coordinates and mapping score semantics. Multi-marker review before biological inference. No synthetic IGHD/XCL1 labels on missing targets.
hypotheses: Vascular-associated B and NK composition beyond total vascular and lymphoid abundance
Vascular proximity and B/NK coupling versus TLS/lymphoid aggregate background
Measured ligand and receptor sources are spatially adjacent
Composition proxies associated with pCR with explicit chemotherapy comparator and treatment interaction
spatial_unit: six source tumors/patients subject to actual identity bridge; cells/vessels not independent patients
vessel_labels: ACKR1+ blood endothelial, other blood endothelial, lymphatic endothelial separately; ACKR1 alone does not establish HEV. Mural/PVL and fibroblast populations separately; CCL19/21 source not hard coded as mural.
spatial_inference: First release descriptive QC and native-distance lineage profiles only; formal patient-level and compartment-constrained null tests require separate outcome-blind eligibility/geometry addendum. No cell-level pseudo-replication or causal migration claim.
clinical_source: GSE194040 official processed 19134-gene Agilent expression and GEO metadata; reuse locally verified complete public source without redownload
clinical_preexisting_plan: Seven outcome-blind scores: five complete original CM03/04/07/09/11 programs plus equal mean and minimum of B/EC/NK marker percentile means; 21 primary target terms across pembro/control/treatment-interaction
clinical_measurement: All panel genes required; complete-patient within eligible pooled HER2-negative cohort gene percentile means, no outcome-based cuts; pooled SD so arm effects use same unit. These are RNA proxies, not fractions or spatial niches.
clinical_eligibility: Exact patient key; pretreatment author expression; HER2-negative pembro+paclitaxel or paclitaxel control only; exclude duplicate/conflicting patient keys, unknown HR/pCR; n>=30, minority>=10, full rank, condition number<=1e6, unpenalized logistic convergence, finite estimates and 95% Wald CI. No optimization of cutpoints/markers.

clinical_models.pooled: pCR ~ score + treatment + score:treatment + panT + HR

clinical_incremental_secondary.target: minimum-component proxy beyond vascular and total B/NK RNA proxies
clinical_incremental_secondary.within_arm: pCR ~ min_component + EC + mean_B_NK + panT + HR
clinical_incremental_secondary.pooled: pCR ~ min_component + EC + mean_B_NK + panT + HR + treatment + treatment:(min_component + EC + mean_B_NK + panT + HR)
clinical_incremental_secondary.family: 3 fixed target terms, separate BH/BY; exploratory, possible small-sample/collinearity limitations

FDR: 21 primary and 3 secondary target slots separately BH and BY, unavailable P1 denominators and NA display; full outputs retained
clinical_limits: Adaptive platform trial; concurrent-control eligibility not certified from GEO fields alone; treatment interaction is exploratory, not proven treatment-specific benefit. Source 988 arrays and 987 patients described in publication must be reconciled by exact keys, not forced.
previous_six_ICI: No breast cohort and different frozen gene-program proxy; negative results cannot directly refute the breast vascular-composition route; also do not provide positive evidence for it.
